Both coins just swept the London low (1,692.08 ETH, 60,692.3 BTC) and have already reclaimed back above it, right where yesterday's VAL/POC lines up with the golden pocket and the EMA20/EMA50: there is an A+ zone of the method on both (a bounce against the 24h move, score 9), but conviction stays low from the background priors (all well under 40%, n>=8), so there is no GO. Today is Thanksgiving in the US (reduced stock liquidity, no fresh USD data). Verdict: WAIT on ETH and BTC, watching the bounce at VAL/POC or a loss of that floor.
